body: Approved plan: (a) clear identifyReconnectPending in connectWebSocket right after `wsConnection = ws` (not before `new WebSocket`, so a constructor throw can't clear it while the CLOSING socket is still current); (b) in attemptAutoConnect's fetch .then, call clearAutoConnectInterval() immediately before arming a new interval in the failure branch AND clear it in the success branch; no in-flight guard (FORGET_CONFIG and the 1008 handler need a forced restart). node --check + manual checklist.
